What if you slept with your makeup on every night?
Foundation, concealer and mascara sit on your skin all day long. It feels harmless after a long day. Many people skip washing when they're tired.

But here's the twist. Makeup can clog your pores overnight and lead to breakouts, and mascara left on can irritate your eyes. Your skin repairs itself while you sleep! Even a quick wipe or a gentle cleanser before bed makes a big difference. Makeup on your pillowcase can also spread oil and bacteria back onto your face night after night.
